<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    d = {}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('B','Y') and 20 <= n['pixels'] <= 80:
            b = n['boundary']
            r0 = min(p[0] for p in b); r1 = max(p[0] for p in b); c0 = min(p[1] for p in b); c1 = max(p[1] for p in b)
            d.setdefault(n['color'], []).append((r0,c0,r1,c1,n['pixels']))
    return d
res = action(['UP']*8 + ['LEFT']*5)
s = snap()
print(s)
print('done:', last_action_result.get('done'), 'lvl:', last_action_result.get('level_completed'), 'step:', current_frame.step)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
